senses.gloss:
किण m. (-णः)
 1. A wart, a mole.
 2. A scar.
 3. A corn, a callosity.
4. An insect found in wood.

किणि f. (-णिः) A tree, (Achyranthes aspera:) see अपामार्ग.
 E. किण् a
scar, and कि affix; making scars; that is cicatrizing wounds,
sores, &c.

किणिही f. (-ही) Achyranthes aspera.
 E. किणि a sore, and ह what re-
moves, fem. affix ङीष्.

किण्व mn. (-ण्वः-ण्वं) Ferment, a drug or seed used to produce fermenta-
tion, in the manufacture of spirits from sugar, bassia, &c.
 n. (-ण्वं)
Sin.
 E. कण् to sound, &c. क्वन् Uṇādi affix, and the इ irregularly in-
serted: see कण्व.
